description: A blockade of Taiwan would hurt the global economy more than Iran’s blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Blow To Petrodollar? How China Stands To Gain From Iran's Currency Offensive In Hormuz
description: Under Iran's de facto toll booth regime at the strait, commercial vessels have been charged transit fees in yuan, according to multiple reports, the latest sign of deepening Chinese-Iranian economic cooperation built around China's currency.

title: Taiwan opposition leader arrives in China
description: BEIJING -- Taiwan opposition leader Cheng Li-wun arrived in China on Tuesday at the invitation of President Xi Jinping, in what she's calling a "journey for peace" as Beijing pushes for the self-ruled island to come under its control.

title: Birds, Not Missiles: Cheng Li-wun's Peace Plea Amidst Taiwan Tensions
description: Taiwan's opposition leader Cheng Li-wun visited China to promote peace and lessen tensions with Beijing. Her visit coincides with crucial defense budget talks in Taiwan, causing political friction. Cheng advocates for dialogue over military threats, quoting literature to emphasize peace. China's military actions around Taiwan continue despite her efforts.

title: Cheng Li-wun's Peace Mission: Seeking Calm Amidst Rising Tensions
description: Cheng Li-wun, chairwoman of Taiwan's Kuomintang party, makes a plea for peace in Shanghai, criticizing escalating military actions. Her visit aims to ease tensions as ties with China worsen, despite backlash from Taipei government members over her absence during crucial defense budget discussions.

title: West Asia Crisis: India Welcomes US-Iran Ceasefire Amid Rising Strategic Concerns
description: India welcomed the US-Iran ceasefire, stressing peace, stable trade, and secure navigation via the Strait of Hormuz. It advised Indians in Iran to stay cautious or leave. Experts note Pakistan and China gaining diplomatic relevance, while India’s “strategic detachment” in West Asia draws concern amid risks to its energy and diaspora interests.

title: Taiwan opposition makes poetic plea in China visit
description: Taiwan opposition leader Cheng Li-wun has continued her Chinese "peace" mission in Shanghai, where she's said birds not missiles should fly in the sky.
